benchmark_status: not runnable on this GPU, and no MiniCPM family exists at this revision

blockers.detail: No MiniCPM / dense-Llama family at the pinned revision. The family registry is bonsai, deepseek_v4, gemma4, glm5_next, nemotron_h, qwen3_5, qwen3_5_moe, qwen4_exp (src/tensorfold/families/), and grep -ri minicpm over the repository returns no matches. `tensorfold models` lists EXL3 only for GLM-5.3-Flash (Mia-AiLab/GLM-5.3-Flash-EXL3-TR3-4bpw), Qwen3.8-27B (turboderp/Qwen3.8-27B-exl3) and Qwen3.8 Flash Next (turboderp/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-exl3).
blockers.conclusion: Even on supported hardware, the pinned TensorFold cannot serve this checkpoint, and no porting was attempted (explicitly out of scope).

blockers.detail: src/tensorfold/cuda/build.py:13 sets MIN_CAPABILITY = (8, 9) with the comment 'FP8 MMA and e4m3 conversions (Ada)', and refuse_old_gpu() is documented as running 'At startup, before any weight loads'. src/tensorfold/cuda/capacity.py:269 states '8.9 for every format'.

empirical_result.raised: ValueError: TensorFold's CUDA kernels need compute capability 8.9 or newer (FP8 MMA); this GPU (NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060) is 8.6

blockers.readme_corroboration: The repository README states RTX 30 cards (8.6) aren't supported and that the server refuses a GPU below 8.9 at startup.

no_substitution.reason: TensorFold supports Qwen / Nemotron / GLM / Gemma / DeepSeek families, but placing another checkpoint's numbers beside MiniCPM5 EXL3 would not be a cross-runtime comparison of the same model, so TensorFold contributes no performance row.
